risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; utilities defensive but macro stress environment unfavourable for equity positioning.

debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis environment (VIX crisis, unfavourable macro), weak trend confirmation (ADX 16, no EMA alignment, Hull bearish), stochRSI overbought, zero fundamental conviction, and price below VWAP create execution risk that outweighs momentum signals.
